# package gdsid

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/gds/gdsid"
```

Package gdsid holds the numeric identifiers of the nodes of the Global Discovery Server information model of OPC UA Part 12 (the Opc.Ua.Gds.NodeSet2 of the OPC Foundation), generated from schema/Opc.Ua.Gds.NodeIds.csv by go generate (internal/cmd/gen).

The identifiers belong to the namespace NamespaceURI. Its namespace index differs from server to server: resolve it with the NamespaceArray of the server, for example ua.NewNumericNodeID(ns, gdsid.Directory).

## Constants

```go
const NamespaceURI = "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/GDS/"
```

NamespaceURI is the namespace of the GDS information model.
